subject.title: auth.order ignored for GitHub Copilot provider — first profile in auth.profiles always wins

question: Should maintainers refresh or adopt https://github.com/BingqingLyu/openclaw/pull/898, or close it and land a narrow replacement in openclaw/openclaw?
rationale: The bug is clear, but an open linked fork PR already owns the GitHub closing path and is currently conflicting, so automation should not create another fix lane until maintainers choose the candidate path.

options.title: Adopt or replace linked fix
options.body: Review the linked fork PR, then either refresh/adopt it or close it and land an equivalent narrow fix in the main repository.

options.title: Wait for contributor refresh
options.body: Keep this issue paired with the fork PR and wait for the contributor to resolve conflicts and update proof.

recommendation.title: Adopt or replace linked fix
recommendation.body: Review the linked fork PR, then either refresh/adopt it or close it and land an equivalent narrow fix in the main repository.
